{{Quote|Thrall's Tale, you are cleared for landing platform FF-887. Sending coordinates now.|[[Imperial Center flight control]] tells [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to land on the platform|<ref name="Star Wars (2013) 2">[[Star Wars (2013) 2|''Star Wars'' (2013) 2]]</ref>}}
'''Landing platform FF-887''' was a landing platform on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] co-pilot [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] arrived on Coruscant shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], their [[Starship/Legends|Star ship]] the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], under the false name ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Thrall's Tale]]'', was assigned to land there by [[Imperial Center flight control]].

==Behind the scenes==
Landing platform FF-887 was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars (2013) 2|''Star Wars'' (2013) 2]] of the comic book series titled simply [[Star Wars (2013)|Star Wars]] published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]. The issue was written by [[Brian Wood]] and released on [[February]] [[February 13|13]] [[2013]].
